verdict.rationale: 2FAS Auth documents encrypted sync and backup of tokens to the user's own iCloud or Google Drive, plus export files. It also says service keys can be recovered after losing a phone because they sit in a cloud backup, which implies tokens can move to a new device. The evidence does not describe a guided, single-step phone-migration flow, and iCloud and Google Drive are tied to one platform each, so a cross-platform move is unclear. Missing for 10: a documented one-step guided transfer flow, iOS↔Android migration path, and hands-on or independent corroboration that all tokens restore cleanly on a new phone.
